optimizedDescription.value: Lifecycle-managed Code Graph facade composes one registry-selected store, shared adapters, semantic resolution, unified search, and curated API.

optimizedContext.value:
# Code Graph Composition

## Rules
- `CodeGraphProvider`: explicit parameterless `open()`, idempotent `close()`; one availability/staleness check per composite operation. `index({force:true})` clears logical state and reprocesses inputs; `clear()` preserves physical generation; closed-only `recreate()` replaces unrecoverable storage and stays closed.
- Queries, exact batches, traversal, impact, resolution, coverage, statistics, unified search delegate to store/domain services. `getSpec` may return undefined. Provider holds no domain logic.
- Filtered impact accepts shared typed filter for symbol/file/multi-file/spec/public-binding operations; predicates reach traversal/store/worker physical queries. Results deterministic and include `affectedSpecs`; never post-filter unrestricted traversal.
- Resolution-aware impact preserves discriminated logical target with all declarations/evidence, exact declaration semantics, or public binding with separate route/canonical impact. Compatibility projections never select traversal.
- `createCodeGraphProvider(config: SpecdConfig, options?)` derives storage root from `config.configPath`; standalone overload requires `storagePath`. Select `graphStoreId ?? "sqlite"`; merge built-in sqlite with additive `graphStoreFactories`; reject sqlite collision/unknown id.
- Factory registers built-in TypeScript, Python, Go, PHP plus additive `adapters`, then uses same `AdapterRegistry` for indexing and resolution. Provider remains config-stateless; callers pass targets/spec sources to each `index()`.
- `createSqliteGraphStoreFactory()` synchronous. Native module loading, worker startup, schema preparation, binding resolution occur at `open()`. Convert absolute `modulePath` to `file:` URL.
- Provider type-only; construction only through factory. Concrete provider, `GraphStore`, `IndexCodeGraph`, worker protocol, locks, launchers, stores, test seams internal.
- Public `"."` runtime allowlist is exact: composition factories; `runIsolatedGraphIndex`; host use cases `GetGraphHealth`, `IndexProjectGraph`, `GetSpecCoverage`, `GetChangeSpecCoverage` plus creators; graph-config builders; discovery/index constants; traversal/impact functions; semantic identity/binding creators/parsers; selector normalization; freshness/search/fingerprint helpers; public error subclasses; `CODE_GRAPH_VERSION`. Listed host-facing types only; barrel test enforces exact values.
- `src/public.ts` maps `"."`; `src/index.ts` maps `"./internal"`. Published ESM isolated-worker child stays non-exported. No unrestricted public star exports or removed Ladybug symbols.
- Public types cover composition, isolated-worker host contracts, use cases, index/discovery, filtered semantic impact, reference facts/member semantics, selectors/resolution, freshness/coverage, hotspots/search, fingerprint, `LanguageAdapter`, model vocabulary, errors. Raw IPC/locks, concrete stores, query plans, predicate builders, worker DTOs remain internal.
- Already-open provider powers `GetGraphHealth`, `IndexProjectGraph`, `GetSpecCoverage`, `GetChangeSpecCoverage`; direct provider retains search/hotspots/impact/traversal.
- Long-lived hosts create synchronously, `await open()`, reuse without synchronous SQLite blocking event loop, explicitly close; shutdown settles/rejects outstanding requests before backend teardown.
- Exact public-binding lookup keys surface/exported name/symbol space/canonical target and returns binding+declarations without ranked search.
- Selector resolution: unique/ambiguous/missing; unqualified case-exact then case-insensitive exact only; no prefix/text widening; bounded ambiguity; enrichment uses one exact batch. Invalid host selector throws typed `INVALID_GRAPH_SELECTOR`.
- Adapter normalization uses shared registry. Unanchored `Tipo.miembro`/`Tipo::miembro` resolves by stored `qualified_name` equality without adapter. Other text requires explicit language, anchored indexed file, or public-surface metadata; otherwise unresolved. Provider never parses manifests/member syntax.
- Unified search accepts query, `symbols|files|specs|documents`, shared filters, per-category limit, snippet preference. Exact file filter normalizes canonical/project-relative/absolute; wildcard remains pattern.
- Search use case owns shared plan, semantic/content lanes, precise occurrences, symbol-range suppression, grouping/ranking, per-file general/wildcard caps, post-group limits. Exact single-file returns all retained occurrences. Delivery adapters never independently expand/merge/dedupe/limit categories.

## Constraints
- One active `GraphStore`; registry selection internal, not `specd.yaml`.
- `LanguageAdapter` public; stores/internals only `"./internal"`.
- Explicit lifecycle; no auto-open/close.
- Provider owns lifecycle, availability, locks, destructive recovery; no domain logic.
- Runtime dependency on `@specd/core`.
